summary: S7b complete: 22 passing round-trip tests, 2 ignored animation regressions; final VM gate green.
body:
Changed only [crates/interchange/tests/scene_roundtrip.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/roundtrip/crates/interchange/tests/scene_roundtrip.rs). Fixtures are handwritten inline. No production changes, dependencies, commits, or pushes.

Public API: none added. Tests exercise:

- `filmcraft_interchange::export(&Project, ItemId, Format, &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>`, using `Format::Scene`; the scene exporter itself is crate-private.
- `scene::import(&[u8], &ImportOptions) -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>`.

Coverage includes all requested FilmCraft cases, seven scene→FilmCraft→scene fixtures, schema validation, resolved intervals and source maps including transition handles, and four property tests with 64 cases each on the requested grids within two hours.

Design notes and asymmetries:

- XSD `projectType@background` defaults to opaque black. Tests explicitly expect one additional background track and compare content tracks separately. Export also replaces a transparent scene background with this default.
- XSD `animateType@timeBase` defines local time from the layer’s start; FilmCraft evaluates effects in media time. Exact key times/values and sampled easing are checked separately.
- XSD `layerType@clipIn`, `clipOut`, and `speed` define the source maps; transition handles are compared separately from nominal intervals. Only the non-loss `MEDIA_DURATION_INFERRED` and `SOURCE_END_EXTENDED` warnings are accepted for the scene fixtures.
- Graphics return as nested sequences containing text/shape clips. Font weight/style remain excluded as requested. Marker labels may change to aliases with identical RGB, so colors are compared by `marker_rgb()`. Caption styling/delivery format is reported as dropped; cue timing, text, language, and speaker are compared. Clip IDs/names are regenerated.
- Schema reference: [scene-render.xsd](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/roundtrip/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd).

Borrowed code: none from scene-render or external projects. Existing FilmCraft `tests/support/mod.rs` helpers are reused; no attribution changes are needed.

Ignored regressions, both explicitly rerun and confirmed failing:

- `filmcraft_opacity_ease_curve`: a four-second opacity fade from 20% to 80%, with outgoing EaseOut and incoming EaseIn, returns **26.5625% instead of 29.375%** at one quarter. Import approximates the exported CSS Bézier (`scene/import/properties.rs::interpolation`).
- `filmcraft_trimmed_speed_opacity_ease`: clip start 5s, duration 4s, source-in 2s, speed 2, opacity keys at media times 2s and 10s. The first key returns at **6s (1,524,096,000,000 ticks)** instead of **2s (508,032,000,000 ticks)**. Export writes media-time keys as local times (`scene/export.rs::animation`).

TDD log:

1. Empty-scene adapter stub: **23 failed**. `filmcraft_one_clip`, `filmcraft_trimmed_speed_two`, `filmcraft_two_overlapping_tracks`, `filmcraft_motion_with_anchor`, `filmcraft_opacity_ease`, `filmcraft_trimmed_speed_opacity_ease`, `filmcraft_cross_dissolve`, `filmcraft_markers`, `filmcraft_captions`, `filmcraft_nested_sequence`, and `filmcraft_2997_exact_ticks` rejected incorrect FPS; `filmcraft_text_and_rect` rejected track count 1 versus 2. `scene_video_trim_speed`, `scene_anchor_and_opacity`, `scene_text_and_rect`, `scene_nested_clock`, and `scene_sequence_autoplacement` rejected missing resolved layers. `scene_overlapping_layers` and `scene_dissolve_source_maps` first exposed an overly strict fixture warning check, subsequently corrected. `random_24fps`, `random_25fps`, `random_2997fps`, and `random_48khz` rejected empty intervals versus a one-frame/sample clip.
2. Real export adapter: **20 passed, 3 failed**—marker label alias, easing distortion, and shifted opacity key time.
3. Compare equivalent marker RGB; separate active key preservation from the ignored curve regression: **22 passed, 2 ignored**.
4. Explicit `--ignored` run: both regressions failed with the assertions above.

Final VM results: `cargo clippy -p filmcraft-interchange --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed; `cargo test -p filmcraft-interchange` passed with **287 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored**, plus 0 doctests. The first full build exhausted VM disk space. After deleting only this agent’s disposable target directory, the gate passed with debug symbols/incremental compilation disabled and two build jobs.

S7b is complete. The new file remains uncommitted; no locks are held.
